properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Mixed object: most sites are ECDSA calls the 'dsa' regex over-matched inside 'ecdsa' (AST resolved them to ECDSA-P256; same sightings exist under ALG-92e838c9). Genuine legacy DSA also exists: api/api.go imports crypto/dsa (nolint: 'support legacy algorithms'), api/api_test.go, internal/cryptoutil/cryptoutil_test.go builds a deliberately-unsupported DSA key, and test/integration/scep/internal/x509/parser.go parses legacy SCEP DSA certificates. DSA is deprecated, weak classically, and Shor-vulner

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT/JWS ES256 (ECDSA P-256) across 49 files, sampled pages 1 and 30 of 61: the dominant pattern is jose.GenerateJWK("EC","P-256","ES256","sig") for ACME account keys — including production ca/acmeClient.go:69 — and ES256 acceptance lists in wire tests. step-ca's ACME and JWK provisioner ecosystem defaults to ES256 signing keys; quantum-vulnerable (Shor breaks P-256); migration ML-DSA-65 or Ed25519-hybrid. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA (dominantly NIST P-256) throughout step-ca, sampled across pages 1 and 14 of 27: production ACME device-attestation signature verification (acme/challenge.go:1796-1801 restricts to P-256, ecdsa.VerifyASN1), ACME API/CSR signature checks, plus heavy test-fixture keygen/signing (acme, authority, ca, cas tests). Quantum-vulnerable signatures; migration target ML-DSA-65. Changeable here.

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.26.0)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings with Go 1.26.0 across 37 files — the CA server listener, ACME challenge/client, linkedca, and cas client transports (tls_sessions tool confirms: 132 call sites, grade B-). Go 1.26 TLS 1.3 negotiates hybrid post-quantum X25519MLKEM768 by default; TLS 1.2 (step-ca's default minimum) falls back to classical ECDHE key exchange — harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure on any 1.2 negotiation. Operator cipher-suite config (tls_options.go) can further weaken. Chang

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDHE TLS key agreement, sampled pages 1 and 13 of 25: live configuration surfaces — ApprovedTLSCipherSuites list and the cipherSuites name→constant map in authority/config/tls_options.go — enabling ECDHE-ECDSA/ECDHE-RSA key exchange on the CA listener, plus test-table references. TLS 1.2 ECDHE (NIST/CFRG curves) is harvest-now-decrypt-later; Go 1.26 TLS 1.3 default offers hybrid X25519MLKEM768. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 usage, sampled pages 1 and 11 of 22: production ACME attestation-signature verification branch (acme/challenge.go:1808) and jose EdDSA JWT issuers, plus test-fixture keygen in wire-integration/stepcas/acme tests. Ed25519 is Shor-vulnerable (Curve25519); migration ML-DSA-65. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NIST P-256 (secp256r1) usage, sampled page 1 of 12: ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256()) test fixtures across acme/cas tests, plus production P-256 enforcement in the ACME attestation path (challenge.go:1796). P-256 is step-ca's default curve for ES256 account keys and default leaf keys. Shor-vulnerable curve; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS 1.2 version posture (sampled page 1 of 5): step-ca's DefaultTLSMinVersion is TLS 1.2 (tls_options.go:12) — the CA listener accepts TLS 1.2, which negotiates classical ECDHE key exchange with no post-quantum hybrid (Go 1.26 hybrid X25519MLKEM768 is TLS 1.3-only); ACME challenge client pins MinVersion TLS12 (challenge.go:247). Live config (tlsVersions map, version switch) plus test references. Harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure on any 1.2 session; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519/Curve25519 usage (all 5 sites seen): production Nebula provisioner — Nebula certificates carry X25519 public keys (authority/provisioner/nebula.go:23 import, :352 key extraction; Nebula's cert/crypto stack is X25519+ChaCha20-Poly1305, Shor-vulnerable key agreement); plus X25519 OID handling in the SCEP legacy x509 parser test helper and nebula tests. Changeable here (Nebula protocol is vendor-fixed; observability only for the wire protocol).

properties.name: pqs:context
